integrity: The proof contains explicit character decompositions, Cartier calculations, elimination arguments and bounded exact finite-field checks. No external scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Marked smooth parameters over an algebraically closed characteristic-two field only; no full Ekedahl–Oort or Newton classification and no boundary degeneration. The specialized rank strata are derived from earlier general Cartier methods, which are acknowledged. Priority for equivalent independently published formulations remains unverified.
title: The five \(2\)-rank-drop divisors of genus-\(55\) generalized Fermat curves
